# Green Gubre Group

> Global fertilizer, petrochemical, and metals trading company providing market intelligence, commodity solutions, and international trade education across emerging markets.

Green Gubre Group specializes in international commodity trading with a focus on fertilizers (urea, ammonia, phosphates) and petrochemicals. The company operates across key regions including Turkey, Africa, India, and China, offering market reports, trading academy courses, and direct trade solutions for global buyers and sellers.
